notes:
What's new in 0.1.131:
- Sharing with another household: this PC is now ready for a coming phone app update in which "Find my shares", Watch and Leave on a phone signed in to its own home use the sign-in the phone already has, with no e-mail or password. Only the owner or an admin of this home can use them, and a Watch pass for a share lasts at most 12 hours at a time. "Find my shares" without a password needs that coming phone app (newer than 1.80) and this PC on 0.1.131 or newer; the current phone app (1.80) still asks for the e-mail and password.
- Sharing with another household: if a person's sign-in ends while this PC is still accepting a share code or answering one of these share requests, the PC no longer hands the result (the share, the share list or a Watch pass) back to that ended sign-in.
- Browser player: with "Screen off" turned on (the sound keeps playing when the screen turns off), if the sound cannot pick up at the exact spot when the screen goes off, the video now keeps playing instead of the sound starting again from the beginning.
- Browser player: changing the video quality now keeps your volume and mute setting.
- Watch Together in the browser: starting a room from a video you are already partway through now starts the room at your spot instead of at the beginning.
- Live TV recordings: the Delete button now shows only for a recording that has a file on the disk (an entry with no file can only be removed from the list), and a slow older refresh of the list can no longer replace a newer one.
- Audiobooks in the browser: if this PC refuses to delete a bookmark, the bookmark now stays in the list instead of disappearing.
- Nightly backup settings: if you change the number of backups to keep twice quickly, a slow earlier save can no longer put the older number back on the screen.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the changes were tested on the Windows desktop test files they touch, in runs of 57 and 378 files, and all passed; the share-code fix passed its 11 tests and the mute fix passed its 7 player test files, two of them in a real Chrome browser. The sharing changes and five other fixes each had two clear code reviews, and the Watch Together and mute changes one each. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full Windows desktop test suite was not run on this release, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit cc6a3192e.
